dict.string: Peripheral Glow Track 2: Hypnotic 16th-note arpeggio. Sawtooth +4ct detune, snappy attack, long release. Use with AutoFilter (LFO 0.3Hz sine, 30% depth) and Ping Pong Delay (1/8 note, 25% feedback, 20% wet).
Range: D5-D6. Continuous 16th notes. Velocity: 25 (intro) building to 65+ (instrumental). Add pitch bend automation in instrumental section (±1 to ±4 semitones, sine wave).
